name: sequence_day
description: Order one day's chosen places into a feasible timed schedule starting from the hotel, respecting opening hours and real travel times. Returns stops with arriveAt/departAt, travel minutes, free time and any places that did not fit. Call once per day after choosing that day's placeIds.

stayId.description: Hotel stayId from search_stays (the day starts and ends here). Use start instead for a day trip.

placeIds.description: 2-8 placeIds from find_places for this day

lunch.description: Place a restaurant or cafe around lunchtime (default true)

start.description: Start point instead of stayId, e.g. the station of a day-trip town: {name, lat, lng}. Set dayStart to when you arrive there.
